knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

## Number of missing onset dates by group

```{r, echo = FALSE}
onset_missing <- which(is.na(samples$data$onset))
n_onset_missing_by_group <- table(samples$data$group[onset_missing])
n_onset_missing_by_group
```

## Percentage of onset dates missing by group

```{r, echo = FALSE}
pct_onset_missing_by_group <- 
  n_onset_missing_by_group / table(samples$data$group) * 100
pct_onset_missing_by_group
```

## Percentage of missing onset dates where date inferred by Garske et al are in 95% Credible Sets
### By group
```{r, echo = FALSE}
is_in_credible_set <- 
  unlist(lapply(onset_missing, 
                function(i) data_with_onset_inferred$onset_inferred[i] %in%
                  calc_credible_set(samples, i, 1, 0.95)))
n_in_credible_set_by_group <- 
  table(samples$data$group[onset_missing[is_in_credible_set]])
n_in_credible_set_by_group / n_onset_missing_by_group * 100
```

### All groups
```{r, echo = FALSE}
sum(n_in_credible_set_by_group) / sum(n_onset_missing_by_group) * 100
```
